title: Adopt the shared wiki contract and agent workflow
summary: Static, repo-neutral bootstrap seed content for a consuming repository's own IN-0001 adoption plan.

target_surfaces.purpose: the repo-local operating contract this adoption initiative exists to produce; bootstrap never creates it, so it may be absent immediately after bootstrap. Authoring/adapting root `AGENTS.md` is the primary adoption deliverable: the orchestrator must drive it to completion, but must not write root `AGENTS.md` directly (orchestrator write scope does not include the repo root) — instead it dispatches the seeded worker-owned implementation slice `WK-0001#SLICE-001` (write_scope ["AGENTS.md"]) through the structured MCP dispatch route. That worker derives the repo-specific `AGENTS.md` content from `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md`, replaces placeholders, removes unsupported tool and canonical-layer claims, and validates the result is repo-specific operating guidance and not a blind copy; the boilerplate is a helper template, not current-session operating authority. A transiently-missing root `AGENTS.md` does not by itself flip the adoption-verify readiness verdict to blocked, but that never makes authoring it optional — it is the deliverable, not skippable setup

owned_work.title: Document local adoption choices
owned_work.description: Bootstrap seeds docs/adoption.md from a package template (create-if-missing, preserved on rerun) covering the bootstrap path, package install, adoption-verify usage, and the canonical wiki/work-records/WK-*.json work-record layer. The remaining work is optional repo-specific customization of that seeded guide; do not author it from scratch and do not move install/bootstrap instructions into AGENTS.md. The adoption-verify review confirms its presence informationally.

required_checks: wiki search/read/get-record checks (read-only; confirmed by the WK-0001#adoption-verify review, not a dispatched worker)
work-record load/validate/dispatch-readiness checks (read-only; confirmed by the WK-0001#adoption-verify review, not a dispatched worker)
generate/lint validation (read-only; confirmed by the WK-0001#adoption-verify review, not a dispatched worker)
read-only graph-impact checks (confirmed by the WK-0001#adoption-verify review, not a dispatched worker)

dispatch/preflight verification of operator-provided launcher config (`agent-launch.toml` role defaults and `.agent-launch` init-config) as the required first-run prerequisite (read-only; confirmed by the WK-0001#adoption-verify review, not a dispatched worker; missing or invalid launcher config keeps the repo blocked, while a missing root `AGENTS.md` is reported only as non-gating advisory context)
non_goals: Do not invoke MCP, dispatch, graph impact, preflight, or repo-code-index operations against the target repo.
Do not claim the target repo is agent-operable after seeding.

Do not launch the seeded IN-0001 orchestrator while `npx wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json` reports missing or invalid launcher config (`agent-launch.toml` role defaults or `.agent-launch` init-config); a missing root `AGENTS.md` alone is non-gating advisory context and does not block. Recommend the operator run `npx agent-chassis setup` and review/adapt `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md` into root `AGENTS.md`, then rerun adoption verify.
Do not overwrite repo-specific edits or silently clobber existing canonical records.
Do not require duplicate IN-0001 or duplicate seeded work when rerun.
Do not create agent-launch.toml as repo-authored adoption work; package/bootstrap first-run guidance supplies the operator launcher setup step.

Do not have the orchestrator write root `AGENTS.md` directly or via shell; orchestrator write scope does not include the repo root. Authoring root `AGENTS.md` is the primary adoption deliverable, so when it is missing the orchestrator must dispatch the seeded worker-owned implementation slice `WK-0001#SLICE-001` (write_scope ["AGENTS.md"]) through the structured MCP dispatch route to create it — do not skip it or treat it as optional. Its transient absence is non-gating for the adoption-verify readiness verdict, but that never excuses leaving it unauthored.

The read-only verification checks (wiki-retrieval, work-records, generate-lint, graph-impact, dispatch-preflight) are not implementation-worker tasks; the WK-0001#adoption-verify findings-only review performs them rather than a dispatched worker.
